verdict.rationale: Missive publishes an llms.txt index at https://missiveapp.com/docs/llms.txt, and actual content lines are cited from that URL. Every docs page also serves raw Markdown by appending .md, which gives agents agent-oriented docs. The probe 404s on the root /llms.txt and /docs.md do not contradict this, because the index lives under /docs/. missing for 10: llms.txt at the conventional root path (root /llms.txt returns 404), any llms-full.txt or OpenAPI spec for agents, independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
